data.headline: Director, Application Security; Advisor, Investor
data.about: I'm passionate about helping people grow professionally, building teams and scaling orgs.Currently, I am the Director of Engineering, leading the Application Security organization at Coinbase. AppSec is comprised of five teams:- Offensive Security- Secure Design- IAM Security Reviews- AI Security Guardrails - Security EducationI also own 2 horizontal programs: Security Champions and Security Internship Programs.In regards to my academic background, I have a PhD in Computer Science (Security) from UT Austin. My research has received international acclaim and has influenced how software is designed, built and tested at Google, Microsoft, VMware, Amazon, Paypal and many other companies.

description.text:
I lead Application Security at Coinbase. AppSec is comprised of five teams:
- Offensive Security
- Secure Design
- IAM Security Reviews
- AI Security Guardrails 
- Security Education

I also own 2 horizontal programs: Security Champions and Security Internship Programs.

subComponents.title: Senior Security Engineering Manager, Application Security
subComponents.caption: Jul 2022 - Feb 2026 · 3 yrs 7 mos

description.text:
I lead the Application Security org comprising the Secure Design and Offensive Security teams at Coinbase. We work closely with product and engineering stakeholders to ensure all products and features are designed, implemented and deployed securely.

I'm passionate about helping people grow professionally, building teams and scaling orgs. 

I also frequently partner with engineering on organizing & hosting company-wide initiatives e.g., fix it week, the annual Coinbase Engineering Conference, annual CTF competition, etc., and org-level programs, e.g., the summer internship program, NPS quarterly surveys, etc.
I'm on the Technical Advisory Board of ThreatMate, helping define the product-market fit, customer use case requirements, etc.

subComponents.title: Security Engineering Manager II, Product Security
subComponents.caption: Oct 2021 - Jul 2022 · 9 mos

description.text:
I currently lead an org of 25 engineers spread across 4 Product Security areas:
- Bug Bounty: driving Uber's public and private bug bounty programs, organizing promo events, operationalizing bug bounty as a service and enabling Uber's subsidiaries to create and run their own bug bounty programs.
- Application Security: building out automation to detect vulns at scale in Uber's apps & services.
- Vulnerability Management: building out automation to detect vulns at scale in Uber's infrastructure.
- Security Guidance: partnering with Eng @ Uber to build secure products from the group up.

I also acted as the Director of Product Security delegate, while he was out on paternity leave in Q4, 2021.

Coached all of my reports on their career growth, resulting in 2 promotions in the last 6 months, one of whom was promoted to one level above my level equivalent on the IC track!

subComponents.title: Security Engineering Manager II, Product Security
subComponents.caption: Mar 2021 - Oct 2021 · 7 mos

description.text:
Leading a team of 21 engineers, focused on delivering security solutions across three domains:
- Bug Bounty: driving the public & private programs, promo events, etc.
- AppSec: finding & fixing vulns in 1st party apps and services
- Vuln Management: finding & fixing vulns in Prod, CORP, Mobile, Endpoints and Container environments.

All three teams have a large impact at Uber, as we directly or indirectly touch the security of all apps, services and infrastructure at the company. As a result, many of the metrics tied to the work we do get reported to the Security Leadership Team (SLT) and the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) on a monthly basis, and the board of directors on a quarterly basis.

Coached all members of my team on their career growth. 2 of them got promoted in less than 6 months.

subComponents.title: Security Engineering Manager I, Product Security
subComponents.caption: Nov 2019 - Mar 2021 · 1 yr 4 mos

description.text:
I lead the Vulnerability Discovery team, part of the Application Security org. My team leads vuln discovery & remediation initiatives across four focus areas:
- bug bounty engineering
- 1st party code: discovery and remediation of vulns in 1st party applications and services.
- 3rd party in 1st party code: discovery and remediation of vulns in dependencies incorporated in 1st party code.
- 3rd party code: discovery and remediation of vulns in any 3rd party software run on any asset (servers, network devices, endpoints, mobile devices, etc.) at Uber.

In addition, I lead the long-term vision and mission of the team, hiring, negotiations and renegotiations of vendor contracts, etc. I also frequently work with auditors to ensure vulnerability management at Uber meets and exceeds regulatory requirements.

Coached all members of my team on their career growth, resulting in the promotion of 2 of them in 8 months.

- Formed the Vulnerability Discovery team at Uber. Defined vision and mission for the team to focus on finding and fixing vulnerabilities in 1st party code (e.g., variant analysis, secret discovery, static and dynamic analysis of 1st party code, etc.)
- Expanded the scope and impact of the team by assuming ownership of bug bounty engineering work, focused on automating common bug bounty program management tasks (e.g., task escalation)
- Further expanded the charter of the team to encompass discovery and remediation of vulnerabilities in 3rd party code by acquiring the Vulnerability Management team.

My team was comprised 6 security engineers.

Coached all members of my team on their career growth, yielding one promotion in 6 months.

- deployed advanced static analysis of 1st party code at Uber.
- scaled vulnerability variant discovery by streamlining bug bounty and manual code audit findings into the static analysis framework; as a result, for each manually discovered vuln, we find 2 to 10 vuln variants automatically.
- Led critical parts of pentest engagements (e.g., ATG’s autonomous vehicles, JUMP’s e-bikes)
commencing in obtaining full admin access to the network of each target.
- led AppSec's monthly OKR review with the Security Leadership team.
- defined job descriptions and drove role clarity for all open headcount on the AppSec team.

- In preparation for GDPR, designed, implemented and deployed automation to find and report non-compliant, insecure, abandoned or orphan microsites handling user PII.
- led a cross-functional initiative to take ownership and secure non-compliant, insecure, abandoned and/or orphan microsites handling user PII.
- performed code and design audits of 1st party services.
- collaborated with engineers throughout Uber to remediate vulns in 1st party code.

- led long-term project roadmap for the AppSec team: (e.g., discovery of secrets, static analysis, etc.)
- led security architecture and security post-acquisition work for two acquisitions: NoWait and Turnstyle.

- led security M&A work for 2 companies Yelp acquired at the time: NoWait and Turnstyle.
- managed Yelp's bug bounty program: coordination with bug hunters, validation of bugs, remediation of bugs, etc.
- performed design and code audits of 1st party apps and services.
# Designed and implemented a TLS proxy detector for Gmail.
